body:
To the Subscribers of Conservatives Give,

Many of our readers have expressed interest in the services offered by Gundry MD. We hope you benefit from the following message:
---

One of the top nutrition researchers in the world has just reported a surprising discovery. And it may prove life-changing for middle-aged and older Americans.
It’s becoming common for people over 40 to say they suddenly feel like they have the body of someone 20 years older. Telltale signs include gas, bloating, joint stiffness, daytime fatigue, and unwanted weight gain.
“Contrary to popular belief, these are not natural problems. Not at age 40, 50, or even 80. We think we’ve discovered why it’s happening,” says Dr. Steven Gundry — one of Castle Connolly’s Top American Doctors.
According to Dr. Gundry’s research, there’s one "anti-nutrient" that’s become widespread in American food. And this unhealthy compound — rather than just "age" — is often behind the digestive, energy, and weight problems people are having.
"Unfortunately, this compound is in nearly everything we eat at this point," Dr. Gundry continues. "Since it’s nearly impossible to avoid, we’ve had to come up with a different solution."
Fortunately, after working with thousands of patients, Dr. Gundry discovered there was one food that could actually block your body from absorbing the compound in the first place.
He found, if you [added this one food to your diet...](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44b0942461414e039a1b0a1a1be00d76&_e=ehbl_gPHp82CXmq6vrNeiReoLFqFF19MIaDS6_LdHeMV8ZTEPhTH85HeMdPwBxxDKMsXBcbVjxX4CfMbU5ttkh5ui0rmGbGGAEYI5oPrxfhPedkOUVu54iikDmZpcllaLcVMK50afxXIOQxV4FhS7PJyCJtgULxBXEeW6NVWx_WmbmNZMZcm6a6uW-x29IPnmmeNz4Tn1xkxo5I4atXA1qRL7ZvkaN6DwtC_9DliiF0%3D) you could start getting back your energy, relieving digestive issues... and even losing weight more easily.
In fact, when Dr. Gundry had a pilot group of people try this, nearly all of them reported feeling a big difference by the first check-in a few weeks later.
They described benefits like a flatter belly, looser clothes, more mental alertness, smoother digestion, increased confidence, and feeling “lighter” overall. *
Since then, Dr. Gundry has recommended this surprisingly simple solution to hundreds of patients at his clinic. And after seeing the dramatic difference it's made in their weight, energy levels, and overall health... he now strongly encourages all adults over the age of 40 to follow suit.
So, with the help of a video team, he’s put together a [short online report](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44b0942461414e039a1b0a1a1be00d76&_e=ehbl_gPHp82CXmq6vrNeiReoLFqFF19MIaDS6_LdHeMV8ZTEPhTH85HeMdPwBxxDKMsXBcbVjxX4CfMbU5ttksAZgyXCtroofxb8QzalLkeyFzRCVwzHbXsOSMx84ESoxUU-k04_tdjZgJmduakIGAs3t0DASV0TDpFreybZICSFY94WzSJ5vSXmOlIinySShOaowH37tSczeFuZtOq9aJXJ2z4uYBPA82RkN8PqGAI%3D). In it, he reveals the toxic compound in food that causes problems in your body. And he shows you the food you can eat to block it.
### [Watch The Video](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44b0942461414e039a1b0a1a1be00d76&_e=ehbl_gPHp82CXmq6vrNeiReoLFqFF19MIaDS6_LdHeMV8ZTEPhTH85HeMdPwBxxDKMsXBcbVjxX4CfMbU5ttkl9BPVkuUYg3tpg6eWMzvwGdxPgjb3QJ70YZJ2X2jD76k1dKoszrcnqr159HRCOdn4uTRGAnlWcQe208u6YDxhkh42Ei5F9d9j7qmyb1vN0hIHKlbx0PczfgxYq9al1kIKSSw1DWMNMNSEI21lbqm3I%3D)
[ ](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44b0942461414e039a1b0a1a1be00d76&_e=ehbl_gPHp82CXmq6vrNeiReoLFqFF19MIaDS6_LdHeMV8ZTEPhTH85HeMdPwBxxDKMsXBcbVjxX4CfMbU5ttklhe9Ru3ZAJBg7sbXR9wSBcguTkVlPPo0P2K-bfOcccz1QOb6043gwmRztDARCGnbZWQjPjgYpzjahtDZsHDl-ULBLVayvXwXYLXFzKwMf6q4TNAn3hTOtAZHFjllt-RkoH8IDkccAODcgAw7FA0qJg%3D)
[Dr. Gundry does caution that everyone’s body is different. And the results you experience may vary. However, the feedback on the technique has been overwhelmingly positive. And if you’re like most people, you’ll likely feel a big difference in your digestion and energy... not to mention your weight.* ](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44b0942461414e039a1b0a1a1be00d76&_e=ehbl_gPHp82CXmq6vrNeiReoLFqFF19MIaDS6_LdHeMV8ZTEPhTH85HeMdPwBxxDKMsXBcbVjxX4CfMbU5ttktFGMfWkTSS47-nu_GMAhqjBrhbOBZago_kUMWD77hfXR1I2jyMrnUh3ItD_P0WTdv3LEBrTn-6d6KIimhjoPyiDgtE6cZvDQYFXr83vepkj_4FU149LeN3MGYaBwCD8mEhaZV-vKozw7h_ALg4oE-8%3D)
["The best part is that it only takes about a minute a day to do. I encourage everyone to try it,” says Dr. Gundry.](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44b0942461414e039a1b0a1a1be00d76&_e=ehbl_gPHp82CXmq6vrNeiReoLFqFF19MIaDS6_LdHeMV8ZTEPhTH85HeMdPwBxxDKMsXBcbVjxX4CfMbU5ttkqptkXzjYxc5ZwtolG_5YEWPsneTq3v8ryuGrCVXd9HG_eYs2vsCWrbsXA8fUnAieWGex96bVwT7w9Je7Wyfsz5vwyF03U7xzXdC3aFiFxIdR-x5HbblJoBnmMPgmTR-e48WLaUL3OHFRKX6UyEZM9U%3D)
Since Dr. Gundry’s report went live, it’s been getting thousands of views per hour. You can watch it yourself by [clicking here](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=44b0942461414e039a1b0a1a1be00d76&_e=ehbl_gPHp82CXmq6vrNeiReoLFqFF19MIaDS6_LdHeMV8ZTEPhTH85HeMdPwBxxDKMsXBcbVjxX4CfMbU5ttkuQc5bw4nvVuKckxlXL7v6FVYW1kR7flo945XjSPoWRx7Lpk8P5123irUBU-FEryl2bwbpQ__Zxw2q9EcdfnhPvU5I8Ba9GbY8Nq7W194HpM997VeLqMx1eK9iN_fXSlnfhZvFvuilWOWRLvdi3kwOo%3D)

*Individual results will vary. Pilot group consisted of 22 volunteers — 16 female and 6 male — and ran from January to April of 2017. Not a scientific study

We elected the first woman vice president ever. 1. **Guy Ciarrocchi is a right-wing extremist** who has been a conservative activist for decades, most recently running a failed campaign for governor of Pennsylvania.
2. Ciarrocchi has long pushed for Roe v. Wade to be overturned. He has worked to overturn the ruling and **restrict women’s rights** to make their own medical decisions. Thanks to him and his allies who helped to stack the Supreme Court, there is government-mandated pregnancy in multiple states across our country.
3. He has also backed right-wing policies to **disenfranchise voters** , calling for voter ID laws, criticizing early voting in September, ballot drop boxes, and mail-in ballots.
4. He has repeatedly **undermined our democracy**. In fact, discussing the 2020 election, he stated, “you don't have to work very hard to convince me that the Democrats cheat at elections."
5. As the Dobbs ruling raises alarms about protections and rights for the LGBTQ community, it's worth noting that Ciarrocchi has a **deeply troubling history of discriminatory comments and behavior** toward members of the LGBTQ community, including opposing marriage equality and fighting to prevent same-sex couples from receiving basic spousal benefits.
6. Gun violence has undoubtedly devastated many American families across our nation – and yet, Ciarrocchi claims that “many of the attacks on the Second Amendment are really a proxy fight by the left to attack our values and grow the control of government.”
7. Ciarrocchi was called “Rick Santorum’s protege.” And even though the Inflation Reduction Act offers relief to Americans struggling with rising prices and makes important investments in the fight against global climate change, Ciarrocchi said that he would give "an emphatic ‘no’ vote" on this historic bill.
8. Ciarrocchi opposes a $15 minimum wage.
9. He's proven himself as a community critic, not a community steward. Ciarrocchi **exaggerated crime rates to score cheap political points** , saying that he and his wife no longer went to dinner in Philadelphia due to rising murders, declaring, “I'm not interested in playing Russian Roulette.”
10. Top Republican leaders – including Kevin McCarthy, Steve Scalise, and Pat Toomey – have been going all-in, pouring an obscene amount of cash into his campaign to **flip our seat red. **
This is what we're up against in November, Derek. It's clear we need strong leaders, like Chrissy, across the country to move us forward, not take us backward.

Kelly doesn't have a billionaire pulling his strings and writing him checks for tens of millions of dollars.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb25bab20-b2d5-466a-9b00-f3849e4f5a97/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) That is the kind of thoroughly dishonest stooge we're dealing with in Masters. | | | Hey Peter,

I'm sorry to drop into your inbox like this but it's been a hard month. **I know I 've reached out a lot lately, but polls are getting scary close and I want you to know what I'm thinking because you're such an important part to restoring the American Dream.**

While I was traveling the state with Ron DeSantis, **I was constantly checking in with my team and was asking for donor lists, endorsement lists, and supporters that just reactivated their support.**

I want to know this information because **my race will decide whether or not Republicans take control of our country back and I 'm locked in on winning, Peter.** I can't stress this enough, but here are the only two paths for the future:
1. Keep allowing the Left to abuse their power and persecute anyone that believes in conservative values.
2. **We can start working like a team to stop the Democrats from running our country into the ground.**

**We need MORE volunteers, MORE donors, and MORE supporters to tell their friends and families to get involved. **

Let's win this thing.

Marco Rubio

Since 2016, Karla has served as the President of the United Teachers of Dade, the largest teachers’ union in the southeastern United States and the fourth largest in the country. As President, she helped mobilize the educators and Miami-Dade community members to successfully pass an initiative to give public school teachers a salary raise and improve security in schools.

In addition to her work fighting for better public schools, Karla is a fierce advocate for reproductive rights. She currently serves on the Executive Board of Ruth’s list, where she works to elect pro-choice women across Florida. Karla also serves as Vice President of the AFT and on the State AFL-CIO Executive Board.

Karla is a leader who meets this critical moment in Florida’s history, and I’m honored to have her by my side as we take on Ron DeSantis.

Charlie

You and I are bombarded with bad news every day in the media and in our inbox:

**Wrong. **

A group of college students is fighting for liberty and may be one of our greatest chances of saving our Republic. Here are a few of their recent victories...

> **First:** YAL recruits tens of thousands of students across college campuses. These students start and join an active YAL chapter where they fight back against leftist bias on campus.
>

YAL's student activists have helped elect over 250 pro-liberty legislators, repealed 99 unconstitutional free speech codes and regulations, and have started chapters on over 500 college campuses across the country.

| **Did you know, for example, that the school superintendent of Tupelo (7,005 students) is paid more than the governor of Texas (population 28 million)?** Or that the D-rated McComb school superintendent makes more than the governor of Florida?

Mississippi’s 50 highest paid public officials make (I hesitate to use the word ‘earn’) more than the 50 governors of the US states.

**Worse, the Fat Cats are getting fatter. **Our report reveals that top public sector salaries in our state are rising faster that the salaries of the average Mississippi government employee, and a lot faster than the salaries of ordinary workers in the public sector.

>From gas to groceries, the cost of living is rising fast. Since the salaries of many Mississippians are not increasing as quickly, many are likely to see a decline in their household income. I don’t imagine this is quite such a problem for those public officials who have been awarded above inflation pay raises.

**Of course, higher salaries for Fat Cats means fewer nurses, teachers and police.** Our report calculates that the combined salaries of Mississippi’s 50 Fat Cats could pay for an additional 194 nurses, or 232 state troopers or 228 teachers.

The aim of our report is not to criticize every highly paid public official. Some are paid to do demanding jobs requiring specialist medical and legal skills that generate a lot of public good. Top performing school district superintendents may be worth every dollar. But there seem to be an awful lot of highly-paid public officials that preside over some pretty awful public service outcomes.

Our report show that there is little correlation between what top bureaucrats are paid, and their performance. Many of the worst performing school superintendents seem to enjoy inflated salaries.

Every time there is a public debate in Mississippi about how to improve public services, it rapidly becomes a conversation about how many more federal dollars we need to throw at the problem and how much more public money we should spend. Our report suggests that this is the wrong approach.

**With a $ billion surplus in the state budget there is plenty of money to pay a lot of mediocre officials a lot. The problem seems to be that the money isn’t always spent in the best interests of the public.**

Our report lists some practical steps that our law makers need to take in order to ensure that there is proper accountability when top public sector salaries are being set. Our lawmakers need to act in the 2023 session to ensure public money is spent more wisely.

Have a wonderful (dry and sunny) weekend!

body:
I don’t like to beg for donations or use scare tactics like “the sky is falling” when I ask for your support (that’s just not my style).
#
Peter,
I don’t like to beg for donations or use scare tactics like “the sky is falling” when I ask for your support (that’s just not my style). You’re as much a part of this team as the staff here at headquarters and the work it takes to defend this seat and our slim Senate majority is deeply personal.
This grassroots team is made up of staff members, generous grassroots donors, and loyal supporters and we’re all here for the same reasons:
* We believe that every child should have a fighting chance, no matter where they grow up.
* We know that climate change is an urgent threat to our way of life and that we have the power to fight it.
* We believe health care should be affordable and no one should be one illness away from losing all they’ve worked for.
* We believe we should leave our democracy stronger for the next generation.
* And we understand why I refuse to accept that our economy and democracy are too broken to fix and I always put Colorado first over partisan games.

Peter, this campaign is about building on my progress on the issues this team cares about the most. We don’t need to use scare tactics when the reality of Mitch McConnell leading the Senate into a legislative graveyard is still a recent memory.
Your support today helps fund the rapid response efforts we’ll need to set the record straight on my work, hire and train staff, talk to voters, and so much more.

Fellow American,

When we announced that we had to pull our TV ads off the air to conserve resources for later, the response from folks like you was overwhelming.

I am so blessed to have you in my corner, Fellow American. **Because of the support from members of Team Herschel, we've made progress toward raising the funds to re-launch our ads...but, unfortunately, we're still not quite there.**

You see, it takes over $2 million a week to fully fund an advertising campaign in Georgia, so we need small donations from a LOT of people.

body:
The biggest question we get is if people are still eager to pass gun safety legislation
#

Friends -
After a tragic year of mass shootings, but also legislative progress, people across the country are still asking:
**When will Congress finally pass universal background checks?**
We hear from members of Congress all the time, and the biggest question we get right now is if people are still eager to pass gun safety legislation?
Yes, we tell them. Unequivocally, yes.
So we’re looking for 50,000 people to add their names in support of the one idea with the broadest appeal among Democrats, Independents, and even Republicans:
Pass universal background checks.
Adding your name is a small and simple action, but it speaks volumes about the size of the movement still fighting to change our gun laws.
[**Use this link to say you want Congress to pass universal background checks for gun purchases in the United States.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_ubcpetition_aug22/?source=em220827-1-15&refcode2=2383.3935704.vXPNWJ&akid=2383%2E3935704%2EvXPNWJ)
**[ADD YOUR NAME](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_ubcpetition_aug22/?source=em220827-1-15&refcode2=2383.3935704.vXPNWJ&akid=2383%2E3935704%2EvXPNWJ)**
We know the actions we can take to save lives.
And we know it starts with making sure people who should not be allowed to have guns aren’t able to buy them online, at a gun show, or in a parking lot—no questions asked.
The only place this idea is controversial is Congress.
And that is why it is so important we are able to tell legislators that the intensity of the desire to change our gun laws is high.
Please:
[**Use this link to say you want Congress to pass universal background checks for gun purchases in the United States.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_ubcpetition_aug22/?source=em220827-1-15&refcode2=2383.3935704.vXPNWJ&akid=2383%2E3935704%2EvXPNWJ)

Thanks for making your voice heard.
The team at Giffords PAC

body:
We did it!
#

We did it: **I'm officially the Democratic nominee in Florida's critical Senate race, and it's all thanks to the overwhelming support of this grassroots team.**
This is a massive step forward in our movement to flip Florida blue, but the road ahead will be the toughest yet – with recent polls showing Marco Rubio and me _tied_ heading into the general election, we can WIN.
[**But in a race this tight, every dollar will make a difference. If you are committed to flipping Florida blue and defending our Senate majority, I'm personally asking you to become one of my first general election donors by rushing $3 now to split between my campaign and Mark Kelly's.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-demings-aug22.uBkXUl&refcode=em220827-1-7&t=1&akid=3647%2E6688874%2EATFCim)
There was nothing easy about getting to this moment. I grew up as a poor, Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith and belief in opportunity taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "Never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am.
There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate, nor was it easy to work my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
My road to this moment – to winning Florida's Senate primary – was not easy, and there won't be anything easy about defeating Marco Rubio in November. But I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good for my community or of doing good for _you._
**I can't win this race alone, though. The real race begins now, so as we enter this final sprint to Election Day, I need you by my side more urgently than ever.**

Fellow Conservative,

Did you hear the news? In a nod to his left-wing base, President Biden today announced that he was “ _**cancelling**_ ” student loan debt for a group of mostly younger Americans.

You read that right. Student takes a loan ... student benefits from the loan ... but when it comes time for student to pay back the money they borrowed, **the President decides that their debt is cancelled**.

But think about it for a moment: _**Can student debt really be “cancelled” like that?**_ Does the debt just “**go away** ”, as the name suggests? **It doesn’t take an economics major to tell you the answer is “No!”.**

**[I want to know where you stand personally on student debt forgiveness.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=efd45df3ab23474b811cf55fcf5316d2&_e=V_OR728DpYCFCMNjFepo-Z3DPAEFSKvbqZTMbFyDfLgZ1Mnx8Cwb3X28wkHNjdrts56Czj3tJYe3eJhmD6JjxCk0MXZodqXTf7Fgb0bTdHDzZuJ-E23MGwz2rXorR65Tp0zvGtv8IXwdGl7FGlWBJX5zWbyGN0OpIx560wyJpdTRWLGwrIR0YvmvJrJQqQf8oa3VTutFz1oHMGwnpbXfXKpKUAe-VCiPGV6jUyJTyC9H8reIuX_5kKuGpBNOlbxX4tVZ_9tY7dH5qK2UAwVPhHD_fWRZxZ0iANErrNj1CQsaTkgiRIiFr2E4wkWFkK0d)** Do you support it, or do you believe, like I do, that cancelling student loan debt is the wrong policy?

[** DO YOU AGREE
WITH BIDEN'S DEBT CANCELLATION? **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=efd45df3ab23474b811cf55fcf5316d2&_e=V_OR728DpYCFCMNjFepo-Z3DPAEFSKvbqZTMbFyDfLgZ1Mnx8Cwb3X28wkHNjdrts56Czj3tJYe3eJhmD6JjxCk0MXZodqXTf7Fgb0bTdHDzZuJ-E23MGwz2rXorR65Tp0zvGtv8IXwdGl7FGlWBJX5zWbyGN0OpIx560wyJpdQJDcuFufyoEvIWMDnOknd1Iu7P6abgsJSgSmKRhGv4CmrwIIeuuCLgWhT3xOAV-eku60Dw--73C_FPiKBwWwIec76Er8E-dK3xkl7rX5uQeEFh_UsV57uBYFUN1ToYYdsPq28STGFu5McbzAwNDPHP)

Every dollar that’s borrowed must be paid back. But what Biden announced today is that these loans won’t be paid back by the people who took the loans. **Rather, they’ll be paid back by taxpayers like us!**

**Just to appease his most socialist supporters on the left, and in an attempt to energize younger voters before what is shaping up to be a difficult election for Democrats, Biden just launched a quarter-trillion-dollar tax and spend program that promotes fiscal irresponsibility and unfair treatment of those who took out students loans and paid them back.**

**[I really want to know where you stand on this issue – so please do me a favor and take my quick 3 question survey today.](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=efd45df3ab23474b811cf55fcf5316d2&_e=V_OR728DpYCFCMNjFepo-Z3DPAEFSKvbqZTMbFyDfLgZ1Mnx8Cwb3X28wkHNjdrts56Czj3tJYe3eJhmD6JjxCk0MXZodqXTf7Fgb0bTdHDzZuJ-E23MGwz2rXorR65Tp0zvGtv8IXwdGl7FGlWBJX5zWbyGN0OpIx560wyJpdTFaTI03SF4PGHcCvpWLn0mII43Ay8ymGoSJmD2LRevSYJ2vLp2GDw2N5VKBheAxzf6e2ysqyr_k39RAVnWv65S3pDno9Iyac0onGjZDF8TRXeqHFTz2MuB2t546CTFA8hEkzYTP6zKXfKLLHd_ZXt1)**

Running for Senate required a big leap of faith — faith in our mission and faith that enough people like you would step up to support us.
| | | I’m reaching out myself to ask you to consider splitting a $5 donation between our campaign and the DSCC before our end-of-month fundraising drive comes to a close. But before I ask, you deserve an explanation of why your support is so important.

Running for Senate required a big leap of faith — faith in our mission and faith that enough people like you would step up to support us. Winning a race as tough as this has to be a team effort. It requires all of us to do the hard work together.

Right now is a moment when we need folks like you to come through for our campaign. We noticed a bit of a fundraising slow down this past week during our budget meeting, and honestly, it was a bit concerning.

My opponent has at least five different outside groups spending on his behalf. Some of the biggest special interests in politics are aggressively trying to buy this seat — including a Koch-backed super PAC, a major corporate special interest group and two of McConnell’s super PACs.

I don’t believe this seat or North Carolina’s vote in the Senate should be for sale. We need a leader who will always put people first.

So that’s why your support is so important. Whether you can pitch in $5 or any amount you can afford, no donation is too small.

**[Can you please split a $5 donation to our campaign to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat and defend the Senate? Given the closeness of the race, we are confident that Our Revolution’s disciplined efforts on Marc’s behalf likely made the difference! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution Board Member Jim Hightower wrote an [ ]op-ed this week about our “statewide democratic rebellion” to take back grassroots control of the WV Democratic Party from Joe Manchin. This summer, after six years of organizing, we helped elect a slate of over 50 candidates to oust the Manchinites on the Party executive committee and replaced all but one of the top Party officers with grassroots activists. “It truly was a diverse, people-run victory,” Hightower said. “There’s a new beacon of light shining down on the government with people energized and ready to strategize with a return to the democratic process,” he said. Selina Vickers, a social worker, was chief strategist, and Mike Pushkin, a cab driver, is now the party chair. Danielle Walker is now vice-chair of the committee and the first person of color to sit on the Party’s governing body. [ ]As Hightower put it: “For guidance on bringing this kind of progressive reform to your local/state Dem Party hierarchy, go to Our Revolution, the one national group prioritizing work on this fundamental democratic change to the Party.” ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] TAKING DARK MONEY OUT OF PRIMARIES Last month, we asked Our Revolution members what you would change about the Democratic Party, and over 80% agreed we must ban dark money from Democratic primaries! As a result, Our Revolution and our coalition of 33 progressive DNC members introduced a resolution “for the DNC to enforce a ban on secretive campaign spending by tracking it,” The Washington Post reports on our efforts, which include procedures for possible disciplinary action of dark money use. We’ve seen what dark money has done to progressive candidates like Jessica Cisneros, Nina Turner, and even incumbent US Rep. Andy Levin. It’s outrageously anti-democratic and this one change would go a long way to making it a fair fight. [ ]To outweigh the lobbyists in the party, we must demonstrate the power of this grassroots demand every day up through the Sept. 10th voting deadline. Chip in now to help us BAN dark money. ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] WORKER BILL ADVANCES IN CA AB 257 - the FAST Recovery Act to give California fast food workers a seat at the table passed through the Appropriations Committee Thursday and [ ]you can help it pass the full State Senate - hopefully by Monday! Our Revolution activists and allies have worked for years for historic legislation like this, and if we win in California - we can use this as a model for workers across the country. Angelica Hernandez, who’s worked at McDonald’s in Los Angeles for 18 years, told us on our [ ]Organizing Call last week of an industry rife with wage theft, sexual harassment, discrimination, violence, and health and safety issues. [ ][IMG] [ ]CALIFORNIA: CALL YOUR STATE SENATORS NOW Half a million California fast food workers are on the cusp of victory, but they need our solidarity and activism! We must ramp up the pressure THIS WEEK. The Full California Senate is supposed to vote on it early next week. If you are in California, call your state senators NOW to demand AB 257. It’s a quick action for a big impact — don’t worry, it’s easy and there’s a script! [ ]CALL FOR WORKERS ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution New Jersey showed up at the office of US Rep. Andy Kim in Toms River on Thursday with nearly 400 signatures from constituents urging him to support Medicare For All! [ ]So far, we’ve grown support from 24 organizations, delivered a statement from 11 unions, a letter signed by 42 mainstream Dems and party officials, nurse & patient testimonies, and passed a local Resolution. NJ-3 deserves a true healthcare champion, which Andy Kim promised to be. Our movement won’t let up until he co-sponsors HR 1976. [ ]Just like we flipped US Rep. Frank Pallone, we are going to keep up the pressure on members of Congress to back Medicare for All. Become a monthly donor to fund this critical work today! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Bernie Sanders founded Our Revolution six years ago to fight for a government and economy that work for all of us. Today, Our Revolution is the largest progressive grassroots-funded organization in the country, but we need to keep growing our movement to take on the powerful forces blocking change. [ ]BECOME A MEMBER ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Dem leadership is ready to give Manchin [ ]more pipelines and drilling, fewer regulations, and fewer safeguards for impacted communities — all packaged in a must-pass resolution to fund the government. Don’t hesitate to [ ]contact your House Rep now to make these demands — Don’t fast-track new gas or oil projects Don’t fast-track carbon pipelines Don’t cut environmental safeguards in fossil fuel projects Separate the fast-track vote from the must-pass resolution to fund the government [ ]STOP MANCHIN - MAKE THE CALL ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Mark your calendars for our LIVE National Organizing Call on Monday (Aug. 29th) at 8:30 pm ET/5:30 PT - with US Rep. Executive Marc Elrich on his win in Maryland; Corey Jones, candidate for City Council in Providence, RI (Ward 3); and from California, Simi Valley Mayor Joe Ayala, and Oakland mayoral candidate Sheng Thao. [ ]RSVP HERE ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] Our Revolution is making calls to David Segal to Congress (RI-2) — He will be a key ally in the fight to rein in corporate power and corruption. Join us to make an impact on one of the most critical primaries of 2022. [ ]VOLUNTEER HERE! ★ ★ ★ [ ][IMG] We’ll also call voters for Megan Green, a 2016 Bernie delegate we helped elect to the St. Louis Board of Alderman last election cycle. Thank you so much for your support.
#
Hi Derek,
It’s Brendan McPhillips here, John’s campaign manager.
A quick note from me here — **I want to start off by saying thank you so much for your support for our campaign.**
Just opening this email shows you care, even a little bit, about sending John Fetterman to the U.S. Senate, where he’ll fight for working people in Cresco.
**So today, on behalf of John and our whole campaign, I’m wondering if I can count on you to take the next step by making your very first donation to our campaign today. Right now, we’re trying to raise $2.5 million to close the gaps in our TV budget, and we only have until August 31 to do so.**
The next time you see one of our TV ads on air, just know that your support makes those possible. Getting John’s message on as many TVs as possible is one of the biggest ways we’ll make an impact on PA voters before the election.
**That’s why I’m really hoping you’ll have John’s back for the first time today.**
**[So please: Can you make your very first donation to John Fetterman’s campaign for U.S. Senate? We must raise $2.5 million before August 31 to close our budget gaps and ensure that we can air TV ads on every screen in Pennsylvania.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220827-1?amount=10&refcode=em20220827-6996&refcode2=6996_434096_beWS6i&akid=6996%2E434096%2EbeWS6i)**

---
Peter,

When we announced that we had to pull our TV ads off the air to conserve resources for later, the response from folks like you was overwhelming.

I am so blessed to have you in my corner, Peter. **Because of the support from members of Team Herschel, we've made progress toward raising the funds to re-launch our ads...but, unfortunately, we're still not quite there.**

You see, it takes over $2 million a week to fully fund an advertising campaign in Georgia, so we need small donations from a LOT of people.

| The New York Times just reported that a right-wing billionaire has made the largest-ever single contribution to a conservative political group run by, in Clarence Thomas’ words, “the No. 3 most powerful person in the world.”
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=771%2E5257348%2ED1FR5k)
Derek,
The _New York Times_ just reported that a right-wing billionaire has made the largest-ever single contribution to a conservative political group run by, in Justice Clarence Thomas’ words, “the No. 3 most powerful person in the world.”
Here’s just how this shady deal happened:
Barre Seid, a conservative donor and billionaire, donated 100 percent of the shares of a company he owned to a conservative nonprofit known as the Marble Freedom Trust — just before an international conglomerate bought the company for a $1.65 billion sum.
By transferring his shares to the nonprofit, Seid avoided paying taxes on the proceeds, and the entire $1.65 billion went to the Marble Freedom Trust.
The “No. 3 most powerful person in the world” running the trust is Leonard Leo, a conservative activist long associated with the Federalist Society and campaigns to confirm Thomas, John Roberts, Samuel Alito, Neil Gorsuch, Brett Kavanaugh, and Amy Coney Barrett to the Supreme Court.
Now, this $1.6 billion is available to finance Leo’s fights against voting rights, climate action, and abortion rights. _And that’s bad news. Very bad news._
Derek, legal loopholes and outrageous political contributions like this have done so much damage to our country — that’s why I introduced a Constitutional Amendment this year to overturn _Citizens United._
But the truth is, in order to make that kind of progress even possible, we must keep our Democratic majorities this November — no matter what efforts conservatives like Leonard Leo undertake. So I’m asking:
**[As a repudiation of the right-wing attempts to buy our democracy that this $1.6 billion donation represents, will you make a contribution of $10 to our campaign today to help me defend our House and Senate majorities from the Republican Party and conservative activists, and billionaire mega-donors and their Super PACs?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2022_abs_em.vZ_ypc&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220827_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=771%2E5257348%2ED1FR5k)**

|

| | | Peter,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $25 makes a difference. $25 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61118917:6iAOy2VNs:m:1:3317145305:A353477CE062957F69185186A98E8264:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

clean_body: We’re just 73 days from the midterm elections and there’s a lot at stake. | | Since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , in red state after red state there’s a race to pass the most restrictive abortion laws imaginable -- even outlawing abortion in the cases of rape and incest. But these MAGA Republicans won’t stop there: They want a national ban. We can’t afford to let MAGA Republicans win. So, I have to ask: Will you chip in $7 to the DNC today to invest in the organizing programs, voter mobilization, and more it will take to elect Democrats up and down the ballot on November 8? If MAGA Republicans win control of Congress, it won’t matter where you live in America. Women won’t have a right to choose anywhere. Then they’re coming after contraception and marriage equality -- the whole right to privacy. We can’t let that happen. And I don’t believe we will. Thank you for all that you do to support Democrats nationwide. Joe Joseph R. Biden, Jr. President of the United States Manage how often you receive DNC emails, . subject: I'm counting on my most engaged grassroots supporters – including you, Friend.

I'm short on time before a finance meeting, Friend, so allow me to get straight to the point: With 73 days until the election, every last dollar we can spend on resources to defend this must-win seat is critical. **But we still need to raise another $10,000 from online donors before August ends to hit our ambitious monthly fundraising goal.**
That's why I'm reaching out to you, Friend. I'm counting on my most engaged grassroots supporters to rush an emergency contribution ahead of this deadline so I can defeat my opponent, who has the full backing of Donald Trump: **[So please, will you rush a donation of $5 or whatever you can spare to protect this seat and Democratic Senate control?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1240-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
The stakes couldn't be higher: The national GOP's Senate campaign group is targeting _every_ seat for defeat - and with Republicans needing to flip only a single seat to take back control of the Senate for Mitch McConnell, no seat can be considered "safe."
My opponent is a Trump acolyte who will be no more than a rubber-stamp vote for McConnell and the GOP's dangerous agenda - and if the GOP flips this state as they intend to do, McConnell would also be calling the shots in Washington again. From that moment on, all bets are off. I won't sugarcoat it: The entire Republican establishment is counting on catching us flat-footed in this moment. But for me, falling short is not an option - not with Senate control at stake. So I urgently need your help.
**[Please help me show the strength of this campaign by rushing a donation before our deadline. Whatever you give will ensure that this seat and the Senate as a whole remain in Democratic control.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1240-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**

Dick

subject: Most have no choice
body:
| |
---
My friend,
---
A lot of folks ask how I keep fighting, how I keep going? Why am I doing this despite the odds? Every fight I have had alongside you, odds are against me. Every fight has been hard. But it is worth it, & that drives me.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yx3cUQBGNTQ0X9M8L6qTDFU7Iynzl3_Afyky2941xwkiokSNZnd9liIwenGVg7m2URtnvDpWHuUvTYCfVc1g12iGXBHOtEcW8wNQEugJnG-hEv4CJIzQlISbpTaNImmRHVUi1PJ1IN7Zymuzt-BqFoqn1-dtN-D5hYL4NRFe15mEQA2gySX_mdRLv_QD2c-pbFvWwkrI_v-gQ-Z5i72HtTUZU2115dZWEkVKbU-DxHACPRHf3lhlzi6HXng-8ImuYwD9QaPbl3dK7h6it_U3VO/3oy/uj2TNFbYQIO5CMuybHllJQ/h0/72-RQ9sSkd8QLVBhzNjKMWBYVhjZkcQHQoiho6gJyZ4)
---
That said, I have experienced significant grief & loss in my life. I have had to get up every day despite that grief. I have never lived a life where giving up was an option & so many VTers don't get to give up, just because it is hard. That is not what life is.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yx3cUQBGNTQ0X9M8L6qTDFC2jHW3XjCPUj_b4UEo4Jo0Y3zzKSq7MGG24AjmT23V1AlqJWZClP_OESZDy-YIEbIz8G7MLY2olNoQu36da4zNaoHG_8y42pPoJ1QFdFMWl1VQh0PfTpQ3pvgdZkEa8WCTYbKcVwyzcMSXig9nAct9el_FOfP3ZRZ3zFhMUCBl40xETsU2gtNFF40iRJZUkNYkj3a0yJuS3rYP8w1hPMYnBf82XikUqjdTkrH0NzL_Kyp1JRbq4PMlSwmi1TERBK/3oy/uj2TNFbYQIO5CMuybHllJQ/h1/PNQ0AxMsbOy1ascdhyM7vDvjAGhimCmRk2P2YXmA6Rs)
---
I have had to keep going when I didn't know how the bills would be paid or if I could put food on the table. I have had to keep going when I buried my brother. When I was sick & had a kid to raise. When we lost everything in Tropical Storm Irene.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yx3cUQBGNTQ0X9M8L6qTDFtn996oRmKQYbAU8WFYxrwtMGpg7x8uCNj-wiEn3vGALbHZenckMglDzgpE3aK5QsfHM44KKAlUd7fybQNwv6AGMmoiccXPhNZErpIwNmwfk7iwpiU3yUMZv-e5ZwNumQouSisGanucE7yMax0XxFLH2K7SOoCB83DP2M3U1G1TCfBxxxancTcojGsTxk2S9siKDY_Uqv5wB2nTjzWiOpzng1RTsa7sAXKZPR8ncef5nLlRox-5TPvwJFOjk3S09u/3oy/uj2TNFbYQIO5CMuybHllJQ/h2/BQLl3xfb6d5JBM6e7_BRvzS16OrePTeGDGxUVAAwBDg)

---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yx3cUQBGNTQ0X9M8L6qTDF3Yv19EZQtrK01yRSfD65HG2c9eZLRjsWuRk6Upa3hUf2WPHU4jojP5tnEt3VnTiNdIWrFnNrLChWoXl9BNkXI2n_3Y7c6r2c8fC39GHFoEENZnReN_QqYPdBI9SIrAAyCbTWybO7OYt2e-v1NdV0Ls8hL6_ixZ1k8N2t3s-LsUXdNN2YCZl0PzrYnXNSTAWzdIP7LHWbxzUCbD-bRyjLBKpcaubulOs4-Z3goBmXQq7mcbw8F9ALXlUi32oCuz6M/3oy/uj2TNFbYQIO5CMuybHllJQ/h3/Ni4a2FEEdQLav2fg8OL6oVk_gaXKh_X--y9xGLQ2Wlc)

There is nothing in a political or issue fight that is more difficult than the battles that I have faced in my life and I have learned how to just keep moving forward, against wind and among large walls in my path.
---
| [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953yx3cUQBGNTQ0X9M8L6qTDFjzawyA7aXekeJ5GAmFZtyTq5ELePTLouC32YlQCNA0Klkr-mxdksqZH5cK2SeC_zVo6MpLiHMMgZEA-9tA26SzE7W5NB3FylutiVeqXFe0rY6qgR89AaIzWaVJj0lbpqorT2IQ-ZsqwwGus10fFyI7br28UzuvwBGzmE-Ib32uBNBrmKcCsaTGPVDXNEj2yGszY3Kw5i8X9oE8q8ew8tD2fCXdb3dZQndsao-ZKI7z7i62FxiFKKIKSb10m4Ba2v/3oy/uj2TNFbYQIO5CMuybHllJQ/h5/QC86Uc47n_XYRSKyxmz8jopIAJl0DHIq72sDRbUJVFA)
---
I have learned that brick by brick those walls come down and winds change. I keep going because I know that a tough fight is a fight worth having and I have seen that against the odds, a tough fight can be won.
---

clean_body: | | My friend, A lot of folks ask how I keep fighting, how I keep going? Why am I doing this despite the odds? Every fight I have had alongside you, odds are against me. Every fight has been hard. But it is worth it, & that drives me. | That said, I have experienced significant grief & loss in my life. I have had to get up every day despite that grief. I have never lived a life where giving up was an option & so many VTers don't get to give up, just because it is hard. That is not what life is. | I have had to keep going when I didn't know how the bills would be paid or if I could put food on the table. I have had to keep going when I buried my brother. When I was sick & had a kid to raise. When we lost everything in Tropical Storm Irene. | I have had to keep going when the unthinkable happened and I buried my nephew, my brother's son, whose upbringing I was a big part of. | | There is nothing in a political or issue fight that is more difficult than the battles that I have faced in my life and I have learned how to just keep moving forward, against wind and among large walls in my path. | I have learned that brick by brick those walls come down and winds change. I keep going because I know that a tough fight is a fight worth having and I have seen that against the odds, a tough fight can be won. | We need you all to join this fight. We need you to do what I and so many Vermonters have had to do over and over again. Get up every day and fight for a brighter future for all of us. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: My thoughts on student debt
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
It is now up to us, and to you, to decide if we are going to stop here, or if we are going to keep pushing.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220827-3336-header&t=1&akid=3336%2E2526796%2EDK5SJg)
Hi there,
I wanted to share my earlier IG post on student loan cancellation:
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=ocasio-campaign.krJqR8&refcode=em20220827-3336-P_OTH_EXP_STD&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3336%2E2526796%2EDK5SJg)
**And one last note: we can keep pushing**. Remember that the Biden administration didn’t want to do this *at all.* It was YOUR pushing, YOUR pressure, YOUR organizing that got them to this point.
They have forgiven far, far more debt for business owners in the form of PPP who didn’t need to meet ANY sort of income requirements or means testing for almost $1 TRILLION in forgiveness. (Mind you, forgiving ALL student debt in the US is about $1.7 trillion — you could undo the 2017 tax cuts for the 1% and forgive all student loans plus have money left over to contribute to universal childcare, tuition free college, homelessness, etc.)
It is now up to us, and to you, to decide if we are going to stop here, or if we are going to keep pushing. I am very grateful for this watershed moment of a first step — it is encouraging, thrilling, and has already changed SO many people’s lives. But I am also thinking about how this still leaves a question mark for those in the highest amounts of debt, who need the most amount of help.
So let’s celebrate and keep going ✊🏽
Alexandria

body:

| | | Peter - This is Dr. Oz.

I've given out a lot of advice on skincare over my long career. But now I'm asking you to put some skin in the game.

Traveling across Pennsylvania, I've heard from thousands of Americans about the daily struggles they face in the Biden era. I'm hearing one thing loud and clear: _addressing those challenges is at the very bottom of Biden 's to-do list._

Instead of focusing on the price of gas, food, and other essentials, Biden and the Democrats are far more concerned about transgender athletes and the Green New Deal.

**NOW** , we're hearing that my leftist opponent, John Fetterman, thinks the administration hasn't gone far enough!

We can't allow John Fetterman to double down on Biden's failed agenda and lead us further down the road to socialism. That's why I'm coming to you for help.

---
| | [SQUASH JOHN FETTERMAN'S SOCIALIST AGENDA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61119492:JwV0C2VNt:m:1:3317145305:1A203DBD07DB10FB21B04FE847178135:r)
---

I decided to run for Senate because I saw an opportunity to give a voice to millions of Americans who have been left behind by Joe Biden. _But now I 'm on the front lines in the battle against the rising tide of socialism!_

I'm not afraid of a few leftist agitators, Peter. But I could really use your help in what's shaping up to be the #1 Senate race in the nation.

**_[Can I count on you to put some skin in the game with a quick $25 contribution to my campaign?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61119492:JwV0C2VNt:m:1:3317145305:1A203DBD07DB10FB21B04FE847178135:r "Can I count on you to put some skin in the game with a quick $12 contribution to my campaign?")_**

---

---

$25 may not seem like much in a race this big. But trust me, Peter, every dollar counts in a race this close.

Thank you for your time,
Dr. Oz

clean_body: We still have so much more to accomplish, but that is only possible if we protect our majorities this fall. | | Derek -- Joe, Kamala, and Democrats nationwide are fighting every single day to make Americans’ lives better. When Kamala cast the tie-breaking vote in the Senate for the Inflation Reduction Act , the first thing I thought of was how it will lower costs for working families. From bringing down prescription drug costs to tackling the climate crisis, this bill is for our families. Joe, Kamala, and our Democratic Congress couldn’t have done it alone. That’s why it is so important to continue electing Democrats who support progress for working families and are devoted to building a better America. That’s where you come in: Ahead of Wednesday’s deadline and with 73 days to go until November’s elections, I hope you’ll donate $7 to the DNC to elect Democrats so we can continue to pass legislation like the Inflation Reduction Act. I’m so proud of the work the President and Vice President have done so far, but they will be the first ones to tell you that there is still so much left to accomplish. We can continue building a better America if we come together to protect our majorities this fall. The DNC is the only party committee responsible for electing Democrats in every ZIP code, at every level, and my friends at the DNC tell me they only need 21 more supporters from Manassas to chip in before their end-of-month deadline this Wednesday. Hello,
When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful.
People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ **I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened.**
They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service.
**And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other.**
Now, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things are going to get even nastier. I am sure of it, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue.
**In order to be ready to fight back, we need to raise another $100,000 before midnight tomorrow to launch our own TV ads, but right now, we’re still falling pretty short. I’m not taking money from corporate PACs, so if we’re going to have the resources we need to win, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give right now:**

Peter.
Before _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, many states prepared by passing trigger laws to restrict abortion rights. On Thursday, three of those trigger laws went into effect in Tennessee, Texas, and Idaho. Now, abortion is banned at conception in Tennessee and Idaho, and abortion providers can face life in prison for their work.
**In at least 11 other states, abortion is mostly banned. That means _36%_ of women now live in states where their right to choose is effectively nonexistent. **

Ohio remains one of the hardest-hit states when it comes to drug-overdose deaths.

Earlier this month, Governor Hogan held roundtables with law enforcement in Nebraska and Iowa to promote [An America United’s plan](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=96b171ff8fa34eb89314b2433106dae3&_m=4455afcc0ed14c599243b616d87e669f&_e=gAFfDlNAuSwA3rYqTLCg2OSEdZACNwlWMXhtXjzx4Rtwfx72Yc6-kIpA-b_qXz1BF8CdtmD8wTd7wfcNv_ZFx8toowfhpyOQIvZ6jhtDhGHmidxsDkpk7dLy3oJ6gv53QbbiqdI18SmkNbwa5q1GA_x2tFTkIN7a1oJ8QrhNj4s56Gm_QkWouCBag7eKG0VR6ynJAWUKhZQUu1rT05oPbpfKmUIFSZ45Nm3yzEJ2f9I4IAQXd2lTOeQ6OGa4IiPPyCnmv4QZ14eKCHeATshOq2pgfNYJJtzT_f3k4y2ZxN2t-pZVkVSt9dzghf_0-XxlBzznAP_wDuADqwBm5p6-3qaTg0Z8bJDAgSG2iPi3IwVF7sWAlrt7jiOHOmx5e5BC-RVx_N2iVKDFZgJsYi1kTjMfShNE8Jvge__vmKPKM8J6qWckq8W--qSURIO3sdN1eOOuFbBRIQIvvTjwtiIMFqWimjUAqjd6TyF9-spNW7acs8skhx6th9CdgqxueIjQQwJXoKuSfHLgk8MW8WpPBmHa5j6fd82m27uNtFjZKzwYU83JjzfD3gzuEv2-6rXd4aI64XS5sgpRojpE4THiXyHyNT0K6YI_eDDxanEEZ0pT0sa1mb9ZFpnFD-8n1si5AaexusrdE_6heWpFhC2KCAAgozMOQekOtTSQPlb97HF8m9mouxlVsJ2SlrTFiEpK) to address skyrocketing violent crime across our country by re-funding the police, holding violent criminals accountable, combating the opioid crisis and securing the border.****
Throughout his tenure, Governor Hogan has been a national leader on supporting our men and women in law enforcement, advocating for common sense proposals to crack down on violent crime, and providing resources to support victims.

Peter,

On August 16th, my team released the latest general election TV AD that we’re calling “**Balance**.” Right now, there is little to no balance in Washington, D.C. Democrats are running the country from top down, with little to no input from those outside their elite spheres of influence.

I’m running to Congress to change that.**Washington is chalk full of career politicians who have been in elected office for years and years**. As for me, I’m just a small-town veteran who wants to hold Democrats and out of touch Republicans accountable.

**The good news** is that my newest TV AD is one that voters in Oregon really must see. They need to see it because I’m running against a career politician who would not be loyal to voters, but to party leadership.

**The Bad news** is that we simply don’t have enough cash to put this AD on TV at present. As for me, I’m just a small-town veteran who wants to hold Democrats and out of touch Republicans accountable. The good news is that my newest TV AD is one that voters in Oregon really must see. They need to see it because I’m running against a career politician who would not be loyal to voters, but to party leadership. The Bad news is that we simply don’t have enough cash to put this AD on TV at present. If you don’t mine, please look at the spot Democrats have committed to spending upwards of $6 million to defend their nominees in Oregon between now and November. We simply cannot compete with that, but we’re doing our best to try. Not only does my opponent have the Democrats in DC coming to her aid, but she also has the endorsement of the man I ran against last time, longtime Rep. Peter DeFazio. God Bless, Alek Skarlatos Alek Skarlatos Republican for Congress P.S. | Alek is a former Oregon National Guardsman, completing a nine-month deployment in Afghanistan. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49839443/363674461/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Y2FlZTU1OC0zODI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TxfmHShXUbgVZ_N2cj8FSBI6PKNn1uuZhiYH10_GCdE=)

Team,
In just a few days, we’re facing our first end-of-month deadline since a new poll showed us in a near _tie_ with Mike DeWine – which is why **[I’m reaching out today to ask you to chip in to my campaign.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49839444/363674462/1367010803?refcode=nw_em_220827_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Y2FlZTU1OC0zODI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TxfmHShXUbgVZ_N2cj8FSBI6PKNn1uuZhiYH10_GCdE=)**
There has never been a more critical time to give and be part of the fight to elect new leadership that puts Ohio families first and end the corruption in the Statehouse. Here’s why:
* A couple of weeks ago, newly-released texts and records revealed that Governor DeWine and his administration were deeply complicit in the largest corruption scandal in Ohio history – more so than we’d known before.
* Just days later, a national Republican dark money group announced their plans to flood the airwaves in Ohio with nearly $2 million in attack ads.
* Despite this, a new poll showed us just one point behind, with less than two months before ballots will be cast.

**We’re catching up, and we can win this race – but we have to stay on track and meet every one of our fundraising goals to do so.**
My team has set a goal of raising an additional $25,000 online before this end-of-month deadline. I know we can do it, but we need a surge of grassroots support to help us get there.
**[I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t important: Will you pitch in before this end-of-month deadline to help take us to victory?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49839445/363674463/1367010803?refcode=nw_em_220827_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Y2FlZTU1OC0zODI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TxfmHShXUbgVZ_N2cj8FSBI6PKNn1uuZhiYH10_GCdE=)**
Onward,
Nan

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49851641/363698304/-895462045?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzBkNTZiMS01YTI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J1SILFxMAbKpXE-kX626QjautCFNea9sG-2wJHvYQmg=&emci=4eb7767c-3a26-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&emdi=230d56b1-5a26-ed11-bd6e-281878b914e7&ceid=5460736) Hi friend, Since we came within just 4% of defeating Brad Finstad, we’ve seen an uptick in grassroots donations from all across Southern Minnesota and the state. Many Minnesotans were blown away by how close we came to flipping a district that Trump won by 10%. Some may have been skeptical at first, but now they see that we have what it takes to go the distance. People are inspired and want to be a part of what we’re building. **[We need your help to keep this amazing momentum going! Can you pitch in right now to help?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49851642/363698305/78570807?refcode=08-27-uptick&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzBkNTZiMS01YTI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J1SILFxMAbKpXE-kX626QjautCFNea9sG-2wJHvYQmg=)**
| ****[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49851643/363698306/1425682023?refcode=08-27-uptick&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzMwMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzBkNTZiMS01YTI2LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiOTE0ZTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J1SILFxMAbKpXE-kX626QjautCFNea9sG-2wJHvYQmg=)****

I call them “grassroots” donors because that’s what they are — regular Minnesotans who chip in what they can because, like you, they believe in our campaign and want to join us in taking a stand against the far right.

Peter, this is a longer email about our veterans. Sadly, I know some people will just delete this email without reading it or look the other way, but I hope you're not one of them. This is very important.

U.S. military veterans have sacrificed so much to protect our nation’s freedom, values and interests around the world. That’s why I believe our government has a duty to ensure veterans receive the care and benefits they deserve.

**And as the chairman for the House Committee on Veterans’ Affairs, I am hard at work to make sure our government lives up to that duty.

But sadly, our committee has found a serious, unique threat to veterans: Veterans are being targeted by violent, right-wing extremist groups for recruitment.**

Right-wing recruitment of veterans is a serious problem that would not only affect veterans but could further political violence in our country. So, I’m working day after day to protect veterans from this threat while also addressing other concerns that affect our veterans like ensuring access to critical benefits and health care.

country's history — while also allowing Medicare to negotiate the cost of
prescription drugs?

What if we told you that if we're able to keep our House majority, and
expand our majority in the Senate by just another 1-2 seats, we could do
even more?

That we could abolish the filibuster, codify Roe, raise the minimum wage,
and ban assault weapons? And make more climate investments?

What if we told you that if Republicans take control, all of the progress
we’ve made could be reversed? That Republicans could succeed in ending
meaningful oversight, and pave the way from another dangerous and abusive
Trump administration. In fact, Kevin McCarthy is already threatening to
strip Adam of his committee assignments if Republicans take the House, and
Donald Trump is tearing into Adam at every opportunity he has in front of
a microphone to rile up his extreme MAGA base.

No one would have thought that we would get so much done in a 50-50 Senate
and no margin for error. But we did.

The work of government is slow, and isn't pretty. But together, we've
passed the Inflation Reduction Act, the $1.9 trillion American Rescue
Plan, the $1.2 trillion Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, the first gun
safety bill in 30 years, and the CHIPS and Science Act, which will invest
hundreds of billions of dollars into the manufacturing of the future right
here in the United States and help bring inflation down.

But this is just the beginning, and we’re clear-eyed about the stakes and
the possibilities of the next two years. If we’re able to protect and
expand our Democratic majorities this November, more progressive policies
will come to fruition and push our nation forward.

So are you ready to contribute,
Derek?

My new book, “If you want something done...” tells the stories of bold, courageous women who made a huge impact and how they inspired me in my own life. When you donate to pre-order today, your contribution will go towards helping us elect bold, conservative women to office in November. body:
https://www.engelforarizona.com/ [https://www.engelforarizona.com/]
This month, my daughter had her last first day of high school. Sending her off was incredibly emotional — something I'm sure many of you can relate to.
I feel so excited and grateful that she is back in person at her school, so proud of the woman she's becoming, so shocked that she's all grown up, and, if I'm being honest, a little fearful to see her back in a classroom.
It reminds me of why I'm running for office.
I'm running so we can continue to safely recover from the COVID-19 pandemic.
I'm running so every woman across the country is in control of the intimate decisions about her own body.
I'm running so I can make sure our environmental policies protect our water and climate futures.
I'm running so we can pass common-sense gun safety bills, so we can put an end to any fear we feel about sending our kids into a classroom.
I'm running so I can make a better country for my daughter — and for every other kid in our district, in Arizona, and in the United States.
Election Day will be here before we know it. I need your help to build a winning campaign, so I have to ask: will you help me keep this seat blue by chipping in before my fundraising deadline in FOUR DAYS? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engelaz?refcode=X_082722_EOM_C]
Thanks for all your support,

| Hey folks—it's Rep. Jake LaTurner.

I'll be honest. I am incredibly frustrated with the Biden Administration's reckless actions that continue to crush hard-working Kansans.

Joe Biden just announced his **$300 billion** student loan bailout plan. This reckless executive action would forgive $20,000 in loans to couples that earn up to $250,000!

Let's be clear. There's no such thing as eliminating student loan debt. Democrats simply transferred the burden to hard-working taxpayers who either paid off their loans already or never took a loan out in the first place. So under Democrat leadership, if you worked hard and paid your bills, you now get higher inflation and more taxes as a result. I don't think that's fair at all.

Growing up, most of us were taught to work hard and play by the rules. These commonsense standards no longer apply in President Biden's America. That's why it's so important that Republicans take back the House in November and restore commonsense, conservative values to Congress.

name: Sen. Raphael Warnock
subject: Herschel Walker's comments on a national abortion ban
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
| | |
---
Friend, I needed to reach out right away.

**After Georgia's ultra-restrictive abortion ban, my GOP opponent, Herschel Walker, revealed that he wants to go even further, saying, "There's not a national ban on abortion right now, and I think that's a problem."**
A problem. You read that right. We’ve all recently seen why it’s even more critical now that our Republican candidates win at all levels in the rapidly approaching 2022 Midterm Elections.

The radical Biden Democrats have escalated their abuse of power against the American people by pushing the so-called “Inflation Reduction Act” on Capitol Hill - which hangs another $739 billion spending boondoggle on American taxpayers to hire thousands and thousands of new IRS agents - and actually makes inflation worse as we slide further into the Biden Recession.

Peter, as a top Republican supporter, you understand the historic need to win new GOP Majorities in both Houses of Congress - and win state and local races across the country - to sweep the radical, destructive Democrats out of power and bring Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda to a screeching halt.

Now it’s time to tell you how your Republican National Committee is planning to make that happen.

**Exceptional ground game.**

If you’re wondering what that means, let me explain. The RNC is recruiting thousands of volunteers to go door to door as well as call residents in communities across the nation.

Essentially, our unmatched data-driven ground game and a grassroots army of volunteers is spreading the Republican Party’s message in every community across the country!

Our commitment to engage with voters at the community level is how we will take back the House and Senate this November. Elections are won on the ground, which is why I am emailing you today. we were stunned to see this news
| **BREAKING: Rachel Maddow Steps Back from Nightly News at MSNBC**
**_We’re stunned:_** Network star Rachel Maddow is stepping back from her nightly show at MSNBC and transitioning to a once-a-week format.

We’re sad to see her go, but we couldn’t be more grateful for her legendary 14 years on the air and dedication to the truth! [**So we’re gathering 14,000 signatures for a _huge_ Thank You card to thank Maddow for her brave reporting »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23528?t=6&akid=4284%2E878179%2ExiXmQX) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23528?t=7&akid=4284%2E878179%2ExiXmQX) | [DONATE $5 TO SIGN NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23528?t=8&akid=4284%2E878179%2ExiXmQX)

TO: Rachel Maddow FROM: A grateful Democrat Subject: Thank you
Dear Rachel Maddow,

**Thank you.** Your commitment to journalistic integrity and the truth over the last 14 years has been truly inspirational.

While Fox News and other far-right outlets spew misinformation and conspiracy theories, you have been a constant, outstanding voice for our democracy.

While I’m going to miss seeing you on TV every night, I’m glad you’ll finally be getting the much-needed rest and recuperation you deserve. [**So I’m signing this letter today by chipping in $5 to VPP to thank you for your years of service and make sure we elect good Democrats who will stand with your progressive values.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/23528?t=9&akid=4284%2E878179%2ExiXmQX)

body:
Fellow Conservative,

We’ve all recently seen why it’s even more critical now that our Republican candidates win at all levels in the rapidly approaching 2022 Midterm Elections.

The radical Biden Democrats have escalated their abuse of power against the American people by pushing the so-called “Inflation Reduction Act” on Capitol Hill - which hangs another $739 billion spending boondoggle on American taxpayers to hire thousands and thousands of new IRS agents - and actually makes inflation worse as we slide further into the Biden Recession.

Fellow Conservative, as a top Republican supporter, you understand the historic need to win new GOP Majorities in both Houses of Congress - and win state and local races across the country - to sweep the radical, destructive Democrats out of power and bring Joe Biden’s disastrous agenda to a screeching halt.

Now it’s time to tell you how your Republican National Committee is planning to make that happen.

**Exceptional ground game.**

If you’re wondering what that means, let me explain. The RNC is recruiting thousands of volunteers to go door to door as well as call residents in communities across the nation.

Essentially, our unmatched data-driven ground game and a grassroots army of volunteers is spreading the Republican Party’s message in every community across the country!

Our commitment to engage with voters at the community level is how we will take back the House and Senate this November. Elections are won on the ground, which is why I am emailing you today. Because of Senator Warnock's overwhelming support for far-Left policies, Democrats from across the country are rewarding him for voting lockstep with the disastrous Biden agenda. That's why nearly 90% of Warnock's money comes from outside Georgia. I know you've already done so much, but I need to ask for your help again. Peter,

After losing almost everything, a community in East Kentucky is standing
up to the coal industry and suing Blackhawk Mining.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220827.mSsjZZ&refcode=em20220827-2407&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=2407%2E346206%2Ejv-JYB ][IMG][ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220827.mSsjZZ&refcode=em20220827-2407&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=2407%2E346206%2Ejv-JYB ][IMG]

We know widespread strip mining has dramatically increased the risk and
severity of these floods. They deserve a leader who will fight for them,
not against them. Rand Paul is not that leader.

Rand Paul will never stand up to exploitative coal companies because you
don’t bite the hand that feeds you. That’s why he’s sold us out time and
time again. Last I checked, Senators are elected to represent people, not
corporations.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18293?c0=20220827.mSsjZZ&refcode=em20220827-2407&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=2407%2E346206%2Ejv-JYB ]Our grassroots movement is up against a lot of industry money in this
race. So I’m asking you: will you chip in $5 to give us a

and gas industries while our people continue to lose their homes,
belongings, and even lives.
* Rand has a lifetime score of just 9% from the League of Conservation
Voters for his horrific environmental record.

listen.

Rand’s response to such devastation makes it clear he doesn’t care about
the people of Kentucky – he never has and never will. But the people of

Charles Booker

| | | | | Peter, have you had a chance to take action today to make sure we get good results in the general election this November? It’s just a little over two months away, and Republicans are still hoping voters will forget who they are. Take Blake Masters, Republican Senate candidate for Arizona, challenging Democratic Sen. Mark Kelly: **Blake Masters thinks he can make his history of anti-abortion extremism just disappear.** The puppet of right wing, ultra-weird West Coast billionaire Peter Thiel, who in the past has fondly quoted Hermann Goring, Masters decided his talk about a "Personhood Amendment" that would declare life from the moment of conception, and arresting women and doctors in the dystopian police state of his dreams needed to disappear, as it was hurting him in the polls. **_So, Masters took it down off of his website, and claims Mark Kelly and the rest of us are lying when we quote what he had on his site just a few days ago, and which you can still find on video._** [**Can you please join us in stopping Masters by supporting Mark Kelly with a donation of $2, $5, $10. or whatever you can afford? Kelly doesn't have a billionaire pulling his strings and writing him checks for tens of millions of dollars.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2b7cae2a-1131-42d6-a4e9-6dbf8a548b8d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) That is the kind of thoroughly dishonest stooge we're dealing with in Masters. It's probably why he was endorsed by loud and proud Neo-Nazi Andrew Anglin on the vicious neo-Nazi news site,_The Daily Stormer, _and wouldn't even reject the endorsement at first **_But we won't let Masters get away with this. There is only one conscientiously pro-woman, pro-choice candidate in this race, and it is Mark Kelly. The astronaut, combat pilot and gun safety activist who fought for better laws after his wife, former Rep. Gabby Giffords, was shot through the head and grieviously injured._**
